subject: LAB-011
check: Model routing package acceptance and consent boundaries
steps: Through labr on research: swift test --package-path Packages/LabFeatures --filter ModelRoutingTests
Inject counting and cancelling transports with closed, unknown, and fully open fixture gates; no network adapter
Exercise local/manual completion and model-tool proposal followed by app-UI commit over an in-memory OperationService

outcome.detail: 23 tests in 9 suites passed. Cloud-off and closed/unknown gates made zero transport attempts. Exhausted quota retained fallback without a paid provider. Consent expiry, changed fields, and repeated sends were refused. Local receipts excluded prompt-derived text. Duplicate commits replayed their receipt, stale commits changed nothing, and the model-tool actor could not commit. A cancelling transport produced a cancelled usage receipt. Transport failure recorded unconfirmed delivery and consumed consent without exposing error text.

limitations: Fixture and package-test evidence only; no live PCC request, entitlement assignment, account connection, purchase, or physical-device qualification.
The counting transport accepts a synthetic envelope; this does not establish Apple wire fields or PCC delivery.
